Hi Elena —

Great, thanks for confirming Sep 13 15:00–16:30 PDT (I’ve created a calendar hold here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456). I’ll run the session with the following plan:

Agenda (90 + 30 breakout):
- 0–10m: Introductions & goals (identify one success criterion for the pilot)
- 10–35m: Architecture review — where Redwood would sit in your pipeline (ingest → feature store → model serving)
- 35–60m: Live throughput/latency discussion with sample numbers and cost ballpark methodology (will bring quantized profile examples)
- 60–80m: Integration workstreams & required artifacts (APIs, auth, data schemas)
- 80–90m: Q&A and next steps
- 90–120m: Optional breakout — hands-on pairing (pairing instructions in prework)

Prework notes (please attach logs/config snippets to the shared folder or paste in the form):
- Example ingestion rate (events/sec) and average sequence length
- Single-request latency SLO you need (p50/p95)
- Any compliance redaction steps — we’ll cover pseudonymization recommendations in 10–15m as requested

Procurement — happy to set a 20-minute handshake after the scoping session to outline pilot terms and an estimated timeline for a reserved capacity quote.

Thanks, looking forward to it.

— Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
